Compliance & Guidelines

Standard Commercial Terms & Conditions

Transparent operational guidelines adhering to West Bengal Transport Authority standards

1. Garage-to-Garage Metering

Total time and kilometers are computed strictly from garage departure to garage return (Kasba base), or as agreed mutually for point-to-point transfers.

2. Toll, Parking & Taxes

Airport entry charges, flyover tolls, municipal parking, and interstate border entry taxes are charged at actuals against physical or digital receipts.

3. Night & Driver Allowance

Duties between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM incur a standard driver night allowance of ₹500. Outstation multi-day trips include daily driver allowance.

4. GST & Billing

Applicable Goods and Services Tax (GST 5% without ITC or 12% with ITC) is billed extra as mandated by government taxation norms.

5. Advance Booking & Deposit

Confirmed bookings require a 30% advance deposit. Peak wedding and conference dates require 50% advance for guaranteed vehicle allotment.

6. Vehicle Standards & Hygiene

All vehicles are thoroughly sanitized, verified for fitness/pollution/insurance, and piloted by verified, polite, and uniformed chauffeurs.
